scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file apps/user-web/.env --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml build

scripts.docker:down: docker compose --env-file apps/user-web/.env --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.local.yml down
